debate.key_bull_argument: EMA 9/21 golden cross with price above all major moving averages provides classic bullish structure, and extreme fear sentiment (14/100) presents a contrarian buy opportunity in oversold conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought stochastics (83.25), weak ADX trend confirmation (13.41), missing oscillator confirmation (AO, Hull), zero fundamental conviction, severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising dollar), and earnings event in 34 days create excessive execution risk that outweighs technical setup.
